Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in the final comparison step. While it correctly identified that Nunzio Malasomma was born in 1894 and Don McGuire in 1919, it incorrectly concluded that Don McGuire is older. In reality, a person born in 1894 is older than a person born in 1919 (1894 comes before 1919). The Planner confused the comparison logic, stating "Don McGuire is older by 6 years" when it should have concluded that Nunzio Malasomma is the older director.
